name: Bluetooth advertise
plain: Lets the app make the phone discoverable to other Bluetooth devices.
meaning: Broadcasting makes the phone detectable by anyone nearby; useful for proximity features but also for tracking.

android.note: Required for LE advertising on Android 12+.

ios.note: Advertising stops in the background to a limited packet form.

limits.headline: Can make the phone visible to nearby Bluetooth devices, mostly while the app is open
limits.user_action: You turn on a feature like Find nearby friends or Share with a device
can: Broadcast that the phone is nearby
Let other devices find and connect to it
Support proximity features such as tap to share
cannot: Start before you allow Bluetooth or Nearby devices
Send full broadcasts from the background on iPhone; they shrink to a limited form
Stop others nearby from detecting the phone while it advertises
limits.differs: Android 12 and later asks for Nearby devices; iPhone uses its single Bluetooth prompt.

story.what_it_is: Lets the phone announce itself over Bluetooth so other devices nearby can find it.
story.for_you: The app asks to make your phone discoverable to nearby gear. Your phone then sends tiny radio hello messages. You do not see them, but a device in the room can notice you.
story.for_makers: Broadcasting makes proximity features work. A phone can be found by a friend's phone, a lock or a venue. It was also used by exposure notification apps. The signal can be sniffed by anyone nearby.

use_cases.example: A nearby sharing feature lets friends send photos to each other in a room.
A pandemic exposure notification app swaps random codes with nearby phones.
A store app announces your phone so a nearby beacon can prompt a greeting.
Your phone announces itself to a door lock and the door opens as you approach.
A local multiplayer game finds other players in the same room without Wi-Fi.
A conference app lets nearby attendees find each other and swap contact details.
An office door reads the phone's advertised code and logs you in.

risks: Phone can be detected by anyone
story.android_note: Android 12 and later requires its own Bluetooth advertise permission.
story.ios_note: On iPhone advertising in the background is cut to a limited form.

technical_bounds: iOS background advertising limited to service UUIDs
iOS background advertising is restricted and invisible to non-iOS scanners
Android 14+ limits some background Bluetooth launches
